gap: Specialist reframing after repeated production patches
opposing_expected_observations: Reported recovery after a different diagnosis supports a reframing condition; ordinary continued prompting that suffices challenges it.

gap: Capability versus time, specialist reliance and stopping ideas
opposing_expected_observations: Hiring despite stated ability and rejecting prototypes separates capability from chosen commitments; durable independent delivery without support challenges dependence.
Keeping a privacy constraint despite reported performance loss would distinguish chosen limits from inability; abandoning the constraint or no actual loss challenges that reading.

gap: Provider control of what counts as a good response
opposing_expected_observations: Changing measurement after problematic pleasing behavior supports criteria revision above the user level; unchanged successful measurement would challenge it.

gap: Worker concerns as a rival to leader productivity narratives
opposing_expected_observations: Reported workload concerns despite capability gains support separating output from discretion; primary evidence of freely chosen workload would challenge it. Aggregate claims cannot substitute for primary voices.

gap: Whose judgment receives assistance in employee evaluation
opposing_expected_observations: Actual managerial and self-coaching uses expose different directions of evaluation; employee contest and known effects would test consequences, otherwise retain unknown.
More production accompanied by coordination burdens supports expanded demands; reorganization predating or distinct from AI challenges AI-only causation.

gap: Organizational power over criteria and exit
opposing_expected_observations: Reported imposed criteria and dissent during a broad turnaround may bound voluntary-choice accounts; worker participation/override would challenge this. Do not infer AI caused dismissals.
